n: NCSU Machine Learning in the History Classroom redlining inquiry
t: A high school unit where students use AI text mining to study redlining.
steps: Find the project page from the NC State Friday Institute.
Contact the Friday Institute team to ask how to get the materials.
Ask about price and access before planning.
Ask which AI modeling software students will use.
Ask IT to review that software and its accounts.
Read the primary source texts before class.
Plan time for students to explore and discuss patterns.
